scope.time: real local H.264 codecs; all media, control and playout timestamps are virtual
scope.measurement: receiver observed delivery is not a guaranteed capacity estimate; sender observes actual framed bytes before admission
scope.control: bounded multiplicative cuts/probes; valid age feedback can impose a measured wire budget; silence uses fallback cuts without inventing throughput
scope.ablation: compare age_only_recovery and wire_load_recovery to isolate wire conversion; changes versus two_rate_recovery also include more targets and repeated silence
scope.feedback: ideal reliable fixed-delay reverse path; no control bandwidth or cancellation
scope.limits: no sustainable-rate guarantee, packet transport, pacing, Colab/GPU or display; minimum target and finite change budget can prevent further reduction
scope.paired_link: same parameters/seed; admission differences can shift jitter/loss draws; zero jitter/random loss is the cleaner comparison
